examples.label: Country selector with search in a checkout address form
examples.source:
<.component
  component_name="chelekom-combobox"
  site="Global"
  id="checkout-country"
  name="address[country]"
  label="Country or region"
  description="We use this to work out tax and delivery times."
  placeholder="Select a country"
  search_placeholder="Search countries"
  searchable
  class="max-w-sm"
>
  <:start_section>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-icon" site="Global" name="hero-globe-alt" class="size-5 opacity-60" />
  </:start_section>
  <:option value="de">Germany</:option>
  <:option value="fr">France</:option>
  <:option value="nl">Netherlands</:option>
  <:option value="es">Spain</:option>
  <:option value="it">Italy</:option>
  <:option value="se">Sweden</:option>
  <:option value="gb">United Kingdom</:option>
  <:option value="us">United States</:option>
  <:option value="ca">Canada</:option>
  <:option value="jp">Japan</:option>
</.component>

examples.label: Reviewer picker grouped by team, several at a time
examples.source:
<.component
  component_name="chelekom-combobox"
  site="Global"
  id="page-reviewers"
  name="page[reviewers]"
  label="Reviewers"
  description="Everyone you pick has to approve before the page goes live."
  placeholder="Add reviewers"
  search_placeholder="Search people"
  searchable
  multiple
  class="max-w-md"
>
  <:option group="Design" value="nadia">Nadia Kessler</:option>
  <:option group="Design" value="tomas">Tomás Rivera</:option>
  <:option group="Engineering" value="ada">Ada Lovelace</:option>
  <:option group="Engineering" value="jun">Jun Watanabe</:option>
  <:option group="Engineering" value="priya">Priya Raman</:option>
  <:option group="Content" value="marta">Marta Silva</:option>
  <:option group="Content" value="eli">Eli Brandt</:option>
  <:option group="Legal" value="hanna" disabled={true}>Hanna Voss — on leave</:option>
</.component>

examples.label: Support ticket status picker with coloured indicators
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-combobox" site="Global" id="ticket-status" name="ticket[status]" label="Status" placeholder="Select a status" size="medium" class="max-w-xs" > <:option value="open">
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="info" size="extra_small" /> Open
<:option value="waiting">
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="warning" size="extra_small" /> Waiting on customer
<:option value="escalated">
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="danger" size="extra_small" /> Escalated
<:option value="resolved">
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="success" size="extra_small" /> Resolved
<:option value="archived">
<.component component_name="chelekom-indicator" site="Global" color="silver" size="extra_small" /> Archived
